description: Niveau des débits sur les réseaux d'accès à Internet : ADSL, câble, Fibre FttH (T2 2015 - T2 2017) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agence du Numérique. The data present the distribution of the number of premises (housing, businesses, public sites) by throughput class for each municipality from Q2 2015 to Q2 2017. They are displayed all technologies combined and by technology (ADSL, cable, FttH fiber). These data are no longer up-to-date. Coverage: Agence du Numérique. The portal shows the English title as "Level of speeds on Internet access networks: ADSL, cable, FttH fiber (Q2 2015 - Q2 2017)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agence du Numérique. Its keywords include ftth, open-data-couverture-numerique, tres-haut-debit, cable, internet, thd. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. The listing shows 2018-06-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
